import statsmodels.api as sm

cand=hic[hic.set=='candidate'].copy()

# Fit negative binomial? try GLM poisson with log distance
X=sm.add_constant(np.log(bg['distance_bp']))
pois=sm.GLM(bg['mean_count'], X, family=sm.families.Poisson()).fit()
print(pois.summary())
# predicted candidate means
Xc=sm.add_constant(np.log(cand['distance_bp']))
pred=pois.predict(Xc)
print('candidate mean,pred,ratio,pois p')
for _,r in cand.iterrows():
    mu=pois.predict(sm.add_constant(np.log(r.distance_bp), has_constant='add'))[0] if False else None

cand['ratio']=cand['mean_count']/cand['pred']
print(cand[['pair_id','distance_bp','mean_count','pred','ratio']])
